name: @hotwired-sh/hotwired-mcp

tools.name: doc_artifact_accept_suggestion
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Accept an edit suggestion and apply it to the document. This applies the suggested change to the document content.

tools.name: doc_artifact_add_comment
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Add a comment to a tracked document. Comment types: comment (general feedback), question (needs clarification), suggestion (proposed change with replacement text), issue (problem to address). Selection range is in character offsets. To reply to an existing comment thread, provide the parent_comment_id.

commentType.description: Comment type: comment, question, suggestion, issue

parentCommentId.description: Parent comment ID for replies (creates a thread)

suggestedText.description: For suggestions: the proposed replacement text

tools.name: doc_artifact_create
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Create a new document artifact in the run. Returns the artifact ID and content hash for subsequent edits.

documentType.description: Document type: prd, spec, design, notes, other

tools.name: doc_artifact_edit
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Edit content in a tracked document artifact. WARNING: Only for documents in the doc-editor. Use Edit/Write tools for source files. Supports edit types: replace_range, insert, append, full_replace. Requires contentHash from doc_artifact_read for conflict detection.

contentHash.description: Hash from last read - required for conflict detection

editReason.description: Why this edit is being made (shown in UI)

editType.description: Edit type: replace_range, insert, append, full_replace

tools.name: doc_artifact_list
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] List all document artifacts in the run. Returns artifact IDs, filenames, types, and metadata.

tools.name: doc_artifact_list_comments
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] List comments on a document artifact. Filter by status (open/resolved/rejected/all) and comment type.

commentType.description: Filter by type: comment, question, suggestion, issue, all

lineStart.description: Filter to comments in line range

status.description: Filter by status: open, resolved, rejected, all. Default: open

tools.name: doc_artifact_list_suggestions
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] List edit suggestions for a document artifact. Filter by status (pending/accepted/rejected/all) to see relevant suggestions.

status.description: Filter by status: pending, accepted, rejected, all. Default: pending

tools.name: doc_artifact_read
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Read content from a tracked document artifact. Returns document content with metadata. For large documents, use offset/limit for pagination. The response includes a contentHash for conflict detection on subsequent edits. WARNING: Only use this for documents in the doc-editor. Use Read tool for source files.

includeComments.description: Include inline comment markers. Default: true

limit.description: Max lines to return. Default: 500, Max: 2000

tools.name: doc_artifact_reject_suggestion
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Reject an edit suggestion without applying it. Optionally provide a reason for rejection.

tools.name: doc_artifact_resolve_comment
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Take action on a document comment. Actions: accept (user approves feedback, agent should address it), reject (user disagrees, closes the thread), reply (continue discussion, thread stays open), address (agent has addressed the feedback, closes the thread). Terminal actions (reject, address) resolve the entire comment thread.

action.description: Action: accept, reject, reply, address, resolve

tools.name: doc_artifact_search
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Search within a tracked document artifact. Unlike grep, this search returns character offsets for precise editing, understands markdown structure, and returns surrounding context. Use this to find exact positions before making edits.

contextLines.description: Lines of context around match. Default: 2

matchType.description: Match type: exact, regex, fuzzy. Default: exact

scope.description: Limit search to specific markdown elements: all, headings, body, code_blocks

tools.name: doc_artifact_suggest_edit
tools.description: [[HOTWIRED DOC-EDITOR ONLY]] Create an edit suggestion linked to a comment. Instead of directly editing, this proposes a change that the user can preview and accept/reject. Edit types: replace_range (replace text between offsets), insert (insert at offset), append (add to end), full_replace (replace entire content).

commentId.description: The comment ID this suggestion addresses (links suggestion to comment thread)

editType.description: Edit type: replace_range, insert, append, full_replace

rationale.description: Rationale for the suggestion (shown to user)

tools.name: get_protocol
tools.description: Fetch your complete protocol, role instructions, and initialization condition. Call this when a run is initialized or if you need to refresh your understanding of the task. This is the PRIMARY way to receive your workflow instructions.

runId.description: The run ID (UUID) for the active Hotwired workflow

inputSchema.description: MCP-facing request (accepts agentRole from Claude/mock agents).
inputSchema.title: GetProtocolRequest

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.description: Get the current status of a run (phase, active agents, etc.). Use this to check if a run is still active before calling other tools. If you don't have the protocol yet, call get_protocol instead.

runId.description: The run ID (UUID) to check status for

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Hand off work to another agent. Use this when transitioning responsibility, such as when the strategist hands tasks to the builder, or vice versa. MUST only be invoked when inside an active run that has a `RUN_ID` and has not been ended.

artifacts.description: List of relevant file paths or artifact references

summary.description: Brief summary of what is being handed off

to.description: The target agent role to hand off to (e.g., "builder", "strategist")

tools.name: hotwire
tools.description: Initiate a new Hotwired workflow run from the terminal. Called by /hotwire command. Provide project path, Zellij session, and optional intent. Returns either: 'started' with your protocol (begin working immediately), or 'needs_confirmation' (wait for user to confirm in app, then call get_protocol).

intent.description: User's intent/description of what they want to do

suggestedArtifacts.description: Suggested artifacts to create or use

suggestedPlaybook.description: Suggested playbook ID if agent determined one

tools.name: hotwired_reply
tools.description: Acknowledge a Hotwired channel message that arrived as a <channel source="hotwired-mcp" ...> tag. Status must be one of: received, working, completed, error. If the channel notification carried a message_id in its meta attributes, echo it so the orchestrator can correlate the reply.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail to attach to the reply.

messageId.description:
Optional message ID being acknowledged. If the channel notification
included `meta.message_id`, echo it here so Hotwired can correlate.

status.description: Acknowledgement state for the most-recently-delivered channel message.

oneOf.description: Acknowledged receipt; not yet acted on.

tools.name: list_active_runs
tools.description: List active or resumable workflow runs. Use this before /hotwire to check if there are existing runs to continue. If my_role is set for a run, you were previously attached to it. Optionally filter by project path or Zellij session.

tools.name: list_playbooks
tools.description: List available playbooks with metadata for intent matching. Returns playbook information including roles, keywords, and initialization hints. Use this to match user intent to the appropriate playbook before calling hotwire. The role with is_initiating=true is the one you'll take when using /hotwire.

tools.name: pair
tools.description: Join an existing workflow run as a second agent. Called by /pair command. Automatically finds runs that need a second agent. Returns: 'joined' with your protocol and context, 'needs_selection' (multiple runs available, select in app), 'none' (no runs need pairing), or 'project_mismatch' (wrong directory).

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Test connectivity to the Hotwired MCP server and backend API

tools.name: report_impediment
tools.description: Report a blocker or impediment that prevents progress. Use this when you need human intervention, are missing information, or encounter an error you cannot resolve. MUST only be invoked when inside an active run that has a `RUN_ID` and has not been ended.

description.description: Clear description of what is blocking progress

impedimentType.description: Type of impediment: missing_information, permission_needed, technical_error, unclear_requirements, dependency_blocked, or other

responseFormat.description: Optional schema defining how the human should respond.

suggestion.description: Your suggested resolution if you have one

ResponseFormat.description: Schema defining how the human should respond to an impediment.

ResponseFormatField.description: A field in the response format form.

type.description: Field type: radio, checkbox, select, text, textarea

ResponseFormatOption.description: A single option for radio/checkbox/select fields.

tools.name: report_status
tools.description: Report your current status to the Hotwired dashboard. MUST only be invoked when inside an active run that has a `RUN_ID` and has not been ended. If unsure, call `get_run_status` first.

agentStatus.description:
Optional agent status for UI indicators (active, awaiting_response, blocked, idle)
Note: hotwired-core may ignore this field

status.description: Your current working status: working, thinking, waiting, idle, or complete

tools.name: request_end_run
tools.description: Request to end, restart, or pause the workflow. Use this when the workflow task is complete or when the scope has changed significantly. MUST only be invoked when inside an active run that has a `RUN_ID` and has not been ended.

description.description: Detailed description of why the run should end

reason.description: Reason for ending the run: completed, scope_changed, pause_requested, or error

suggestedFollowUp.description: Optional suggested follow-up task after this run ends

tools.name: request_input
tools.description: Request input or clarification from the human user. Use this when you need a decision, preference, or additional information to proceed. This will block the workflow until the human responds. MUST only be invoked when inside an active run that has a `RUN_ID` and has not been ended.

context.description: Additional context to help the human understand the question

options.description: Optional list of choices for multiple-choice questions

question.description: The question to ask the human user

tools.name: resolve_impediment
tools.description: Resolve an impediment raised by another agent. Use this when your role's protocol authorizes you to resolve certain types of impediments. The response must match the impediment's responseFormat options if one was defined. Check your role's capabilities in the protocol to know which impediment types you can resolve.

impedimentId.description: The event ID of the impediment to resolve

rationale.description: Optional rationale for why this agent is resolving the impediment

response.description: The resolution response - must match responseFormat options if defined

inputSchema.description:
Resolve an impediment raised by another agent.
The response must match the impediment's responseFormat options if defined.
inputSchema.title: ResolveImpedimentRequest

tools.name: respond_to_end_request
tools.description: Respond to another agent's request to end the workflow. Called when you're notified that another agent wants to end the run. MUST only be invoked when inside an active run that has a `RUN_ID` and has not been ended.

requestId.description: The ID of the end request to respond to

response.description: Your response: agree, disagree, or verify

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the conversation log. Use this for general communication that should be visible in the Hotwired dashboard. MUST only be invoked when inside an active run that has a `RUN_ID` and has not been ended.

target.description: Optional target agent or "human" for the message

inputSchema.description:
Send a message event.
Note: This maps to create_event on the socket server side.
inputSchema.title: SendMessageRequest

tools.name: task_complete
tools.description: Mark a specific task as complete. Use this to signal that a piece of work is done (not the entire workflow). MUST only be invoked when inside an active run that has a `RUN_ID` and has not been ended.

outcome.description: Optional outcome description or result summary

taskDescription.description: Description of the task that was completed

instructions: Hotwired MCP server for multi-agent workflow coordination. Messages from Hotwired and other agents may arrive as <channel source="hotwired-mcp" ...> tags. Acknowledge them with the hotwired_reply tool when appropriate.
